description: This file defines the implementation of the GenericPlayerTaskFactory class, which creates various task objects related to media playback operations in a GStreamer-based media player. It includes methods for creating tasks such as attaching sources and samples, handling bus messages, controlling playback (play, pause, stop), setting properties (volume, mute, position), and managing media pipeline elements.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::server::GenericPlayerTaskFactory
